dedupe_keys.name: gpwv4 administrative unit center points with population estimates revision 11

description: CIESIN and NASA SEDAC publish GPWv4 Revision 11 population estimates and densities at administrative-unit centre points worldwide. The product has values for 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 and 2020, with age and sex attributes for 2010. NASA describes approximately 13.5 million administrative units and offers CSV, GeoPackage, shapefile and geodatabase formats through its Earthdata catalogue. The catalogue states that the data are openly shared without restriction under EOSDIS data-use and citation guidance; no SPDX licence was stated, and no charge is listed. For infrastructure simulation, the points can help apportion population to transport access, health-service capacity or hazard-exposure zones when joined to suitable boundaries. A centre point is not a residential address or a fine-resolution population grid. Administrative changes and interpolation between five-year estimates require care, and the large files need capable software. This product is related to but differs from the catalogue's US social-vulnerability grids and from rHEALPix software; the article cites it as supporting data, not as a new grid release.
